summary: Iranian President Pezeshkian reiterated calls for ending the war with the United States while declaring Iran "victorious," amid reports of worsening economic conditions including potential nationwide fuel shortages. Israeli forces conducted precision strikes in northern Gaza, destroying a Hamas observation post 50 meters from the ceasefire line near Kamal Adwan Hospital. Ship-to-ship oil transfers in the Oman Sea reached approximately 25 million barrels as regional countries circumvent the US naval blockade on Iranian oil exports.
key_points: Masoud Pezeshkian stated that war is not always a solution and Iran can pass this path through wisdom and thought, while simultaneously calling Iran "victorious on the field." (Source: @VahidOnline/78050)

Israeli forces destroyed a Hamas observation post approximately 50 meters from the ceasefire line in northern Gaza near Kamal Adwan Hospital, eliminating several terrorists. (Source: @yediotnews25/134339)

Tanker Tracker reported at least 15 ship-to-ship operations transferring approximately 25 million barrels of oil and petroleum products in the Oman Sea using vessels with AIS disabled. (Source: @mamlekate/104240)
Japan and Kuwait foreign ministers discussed reopening the Strait of Hormuz and resuming US-Iran negotiations to reach a final agreement including Iran's nuclear issue. (Source: @SharghDaily/180210)
Iranian Parliament Vice Speaker Ali Nikzad announced reduction of fuel quotas, with the 70-liter quota at 3,000 tomans reduced to 50 liters. (Source: @VahidOnline/78039)
IDF soldiers arrested a female terrorist with a knife at Ganot junction in Samaria who planned a stabbing attack, with no casualties reported. (Source: @New_security8200/203443)
Trump stated he will have a victory in Iran "very soon" following his Venezuela success, while claiming Khamenei is severely injured on his left side. (Source: @asafroz/52781)
An Israeli drone dropped a sound bomb over Mansouri town in Lebanon, according to local reports. (Source: @redlinkleb/38798)

sections.executive_summary: Iranian President Pezeshkian publicly advocated for ending the war with the United States while maintaining face-saving rhetoric, amid deepening economic crisis with potential fuel ration cuts. Israeli military operations continued in the Gaza Strip with precision strikes targeting Hamas infrastructure. Regional diplomatic efforts are intensifying, with Japan and Kuwait leading calls for Strait of Hormuz reopening and US-Iran nuclear negotiations to resume.

points: President Masoud Pezeshkian reiterated his position that war with the United States should end, stating "war is not always a solution" and that Iran can pass this path through "wisdom and thought," while simultaneously calling Iran "victorious on the field." (Source: @VahidOnline/78050)

Ali Nikzad, Vice Speaker of Iran's Parliament, announced reduction of fuel quotas based on latest parliamentary decisions, with the 70-liter quota at 3,000 tomans being reduced to 50 liters, and the 30-liter quota at 5,000 tomans reduced to 15 liters. (Source: @VahidOnline/78039)

Trump claimed in a radio interview that Khamenei is not dead but was severely injured on the left side of his body, including his hand and leg, and that senior Iranian officials continuously "put on a show" when visiting to receive his blessing. (Source: @asafroz/52781)

Field reports from Rafsanjan indicate severe fuel quality issues, with residents reporting that out of 20 liters of purchased fuel, only 5 liters was actual gasoline and 15 liters was water, causing vehicle breakdowns. (Source: @kianmeli1/91119)
Social media commentary notes Iran's economic situation is deteriorating rapidly with nationwide petrol shortage becoming increasingly likely in the coming months. (Source: @shin_persian/9108)

Israeli forces destroyed a Hamas observation post and weapons warehouse in northern Gaza, approximately 50 meters from the ceasefire line, eliminating several terrorists who had planned terror attacks against Israeli forces. (Source: @yediotnews25/134339)

The destroyed Hamas structure was located approximately 70 meters from Kamal Adwan Hospital and 170 meters from a school, posing direct threats to Israeli forces operating in the area in accordance with the ceasefire agreement. (Source: @inon_yttach/9955)

IDF soldiers arrested a female terrorist with a knife at Ganot junction in the Samaria brigade following Shin Bet intelligence, after receiving information about her intention to carry out a stabbing attack, with no casualties reported. (Source: @New_security8200/203443)

Israeli Army Spokesperson reported a false alarm regarding rocket and missile fire near Kibbutz Alumim distributed through the Home Front Command application, with no security threat identified. (Source: @almogboker78/18061)

Knesset member Gideon Sa'ar announced he is accelerating efforts for unity bloc mergers, with a positive meeting held between his party chairman Gidona Sa'ar and Blue and White chairman Benny Gantz, with another meeting planned. (Source: @amitsegal/64255)

Israeli forces destroyed a Hamas observation post approximately 50 meters from the ceasefire line in northern Gaza that was used to plan terrorist attacks against Israeli troops, eliminating several militants in the strike. (Source: @yediotnews25/134339)

The destroyed structure served as both an observation post and weapons warehouse for Hamas, with terror plots planned against Israeli forces operating in accordance with the ceasefire agreement in the area. (Source: @inon_yttach/9955)

The Hamas infrastructure was located dangerously close to civilian structures, specifically approximately 70 meters from Kamal Adwan Hospital and 170 meters from a school, complicating the operational environment. (Source: @inon_yttach/9955)
Israeli forces continue operations to eliminate threats near civilian infrastructure in the northern Gaza Strip while maintaining ceasefire agreement compliance. (Source: @inon_yttach/9955)

An Israeli drone dropped a sound bomb over Mansouri town, according to local reports from Lebanon, marking a continuation of low-level Israeli aerial activities near the Lebanon border area. (Source: @redlinkleb/38798)

The Israeli Army stated it will continue work to remove what it considers threats in southern Lebanon while remaining committed to the ceasefire agreement, indicating ongoing operational tensions along the border. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387024)

Israeli activities in Lebanon continue to focus on removing perceived threats in southern Lebanon while maintaining formal commitment to the ceasefire framework established with Lebanon. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/387024)

Turkish President Erdogan stated that Turkey is aware of what certain actors are attempting in Syria and will not allow blood-soaked scenarios planned for the region, emphasizing Turkey will never compromise on its principles or national interests. (Source: @asafroz/52743)

Erdogan affirmed Turkey will continue supporting neighbors including Syria to stand on their own feet, rejecting criticism from what he described as criminal networks with blood on their hands. (Source: @asafroz/52743)

Turkish foreign policy is determined solely by the Turkish people, with no external actors able to dictate direction or set boundaries for Turkey's regional engagement from Syria to Iraq. (Source: @asafroz/52743)

Japan and Kuwait foreign ministers discussed reopening the Strait of Hormuz and guaranteeing safe passage through this strategic waterway amid US-Iran tensions, emphasizing the importance of free and secure passage without additional costs. (Source: @SharghDaily/180210)

Japanese Foreign Minister Toshimitsu Motegi stated Japan considers the immediate reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and resumption of US-Iran negotiations for a final agreement including Iran's nuclear issue to be important priorities. (Source: @SharghDaily/180210)

Ship-to-ship oil transfer operations in the Oman Sea reached approximately 25 million barrels with at least 15 operations conducted, with cargoes originating from nearly all regional countries except Iran, using vessels with automatic identification systems disabled. (Source: @mamlekate/104240)

Regional countries are covertly routing oil through the Oman Sea with assistance from US naval forces, transferring cargoes to other tankers for onward journey to global markets using methods previously employed by Iran for clandestine oil exports. (Source: @mamlekate/104240)

The UAE has begun local production of the Guardian drone interceptor system at a rate of 30 interceptors per day, designed to counter drones such as the Shahed, in parallel with manufacturing the Coyote system. (Source: @shin_persian/9103)

sections.threat_assessment: The Israeli military continues precision operations in northern Gaza targeting Hamas observation infrastructure near civilian buildings, demonstrating willingness to operate close to hospitals and schools despite international sensitivities. Iran's internal economic deterioration, including potential fuel shortages and quality issues, creates potential instability vectors that could affect regional calculations. The convergence of Iran's economic crisis with continued ceasefire enforcement operations in Gaza and Lebanon suggests the operational environment remains volatile with potential for rapid escalation if economic pressures trigger policy shifts in Tehran.
sections.regional_response: Diplomatic activity is intensifying with Japan and Kuwait leading international efforts to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and resume US-Iran nuclear negotiations, potentially offering Iran economic relief in exchange for nuclear concessions. The UAE is advancing domestic drone interceptor production at 30 units per day, indicating regional investment in counter-UAS capabilities amid heightened aerial threats. Turkey continues asserting its independent regional role, with President Erdogan emphasizing Turkey will not compromise on principles while supporting neighbors in the region.
sections.intelligence_notes: Trump's claims about Khamenei's severe injury lack independent verification and appear to be from a radio interview without supporting intelligence sources. Ship-to-ship oil transfers at 25 million barrels represent significant circumvention of US sanctions regime, with regional actors using methods previously associated with Iranian covert oil exports. Israeli operations maintaining 50-meter proximity to ceasefire lines while destroying Hamas infrastructure suggest interpretation of ceasefire terms that permits continued counterterrorism operations within designated zones.
